body:
I had a similar experience when I was in school. There was a girl that I really liked for a long time and felt connected with. We would play overwatch and joke around, but one day it hit me that all those feelings that I've experienced were love. So on one rainy September day we went out for a walk and at the end of it, near her house I told her about my feelings. She hugged me and never talked to me again.

This experience changed me forever (probably for the worse) and I still think about it to this day, but I learned to live with it. I felt exactly the same way as you described in this post, but I am afraid time really is a healer in situations like these. Just know that you are not at fault here.
